facts.label: Planos com o present continuous
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para planos combinados: I’m going to the mountains. We’re staying in a cabin. What are you doing on Sunday?

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para planos já combinados, use am/is/are + verbo com -ing: I’m going to the mountains. A frase soa natural e mostra que o plano está marcado, com data e lugar.

facts.label: Palavras de tempo
facts.sub: Junte uma palavra de tempo: this weekend, tomorrow, on Sunday, at noon. Sem a palavra de tempo, a frase pode falar de agora. Com ela, fala do futuro.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The present continuous can talk about plans.
We say “I going to the mountains”.
“We’re staying in a cabin” is a plan.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

answers: The present continuous can talk about plans. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I going to the mountains”. → Falso (We say I’m going.)
“We’re staying in a cabin” is a plan. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
